turns.question: Our books close on Amsterdam time. What was our revenue in September 2026, cancelled orders left out, counting each order on its calendar day in Amsterdam?
turns.answer: September 2026 revenue was EUR 12,582.75 from non-cancelled orders dated 1 to 30 September 2026, but the semantic layer counts each order on its UTC order day (the revenue metric has one definition and no Amsterdam option), so this is not the Amsterdam-day figure you asked for. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
